messages.content: Which online bookstore sells 'To Kill a Mockingbird'?

function.name: add_product_to_cart
function.description: This function allows users to add a product to their cart. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

quantity.description: The number of this product to add to the cart

cart_id.description: The ID of the cart, if no ID is given a new cart is created

message.content:
I’m sorry I don’t know where you’re located so I’ll give you some options:

| Online retailer | How to check |
|-----------------|--------------|
| **Amazon** – Search “To Kill a Mockingbird” in the Books section. |
| **Barnes & Noble (BN.com)** – Use the search bar at the top of the page. |
| **Book Depository** – Free worldwide shipping; simply type the title into the search box. |
| **IndieBound** – Find independent local booksellers who may carry it. |
| **Google Shopping / eBay** – Compare prices from multiple sellers. |

If you prefer a physical copy, most big‑box stores such as Walmart, Target, and Costco also sell popular titles through their online portals. If you want a digital version, Kindle, Kobo, Apple Books, Google Play Books, and Audible all offer electronic copies—just enter the book’s name in their respective app or website search bars.

Let me know if you'd like help locating a particular edition (hardcover, paperback, audiobook) or finding a discount!
message.reasoning:
The user asks which online bookstore sells 'To Kill a Mockingbird', but we don't have browsing capability or knowledge about specific bookstores' inventory. We can provide general information and suggest checking major retailers like Amazon, Barnes & Noble, Book Depository, etc., and recommend searching on those sites.

We should not call any tool because there's no need; it's just an informational question. We'll respond with helpful suggestions.
